posts.title: The cost of context switching
posts.excerpt: How fragmented tools quietly consume your team’s attention.
posts.description:
Every handoff costs attention. The most resilient teams design a shared place for context, decisions, and the work that follows.

Make the next step obvious

When progress is visible, people can move without waiting for another meeting.

posts.title: A better weekly planning ritual
posts.excerpt: A lightweight routine that gives every teammate a clear week ahead.
posts.description:
Weekly planning is not about producing a perfect forecast. It is about making the important trade-offs visible before the work begins.

Start with outcomes

Name the result you want, then decide what deserves attention now.

posts.title: What shipped in Flowstack 1.4
posts.excerpt: New views, simpler approvals, and a faster way to find the work that needs you.
posts.description:
Flowstack 1.4 makes it easier to see momentum across your workspace, without adding more dashboard noise.

Designed for the handoff

Approvals now stay attached to the decision, so the next person has the full picture.
posts.metaDescription: New views, simpler approvals, and a faster way to find the work that needs you.

posts.title: How to make decisions that stick

posts.description: A documented decision is not bureaucracy. It is a gift to the people who need to build, explain, and revisit the work later.

item.question: How quickly can we get started?
item.answer: Create your workspace in minutes, then invite your team when you are ready.

item.answer: Yes. You can upgrade or change your plan whenever your needs change.

item.question: Is Flowstack suitable for a growing team?
item.answer: Yes. The workflow works for a small focused team and scales with clear permissions and projects.
